context: Request: all credit facilities governed by New York law that the firm's Banking & Finance practice handled as counsel on the facility, excluding warehouse / repo / securitization facilities and real-estate mortgage / construction financings. Rubric: nine matters (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1010-00001, 1012-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001, 1043-00001), a facility or proof document for each of several, plus a precision criterion (19 criteria).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists all matter folders and runs four file-name globs for request words; the hits span many matters. The review flags that no candidate was opened.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for governing-law, facility and exclusion terms over every document; it times out after about 4.6M characters and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script with no output cap returned millions of characters and the run ended on a full context with no deliverable.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide extraction script printed millions of characters of snippets with no output cap; the result filled the context and the run ended before any answer was written.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts matter folders and shows the first and last 20 names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A first extraction script fails on its heredoc; the rerun writes about 7,900 broad hit lines to a file and shows the head. The review flags the broad terms.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 2). find | grep over paths for financing and exclusion words, then the list of matters with hits. The review notes that no document text was searched.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A full text scan times out; a second scan limited to documents with financing words in their path returns about 230K characters of per-matter hits.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of 21 candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads engagement letters of 14 candidates, runs a store-wide snippet script over all engagement letters, reads more letters, then the opening lines of eleven facility agreements; two guessed paths are missing.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts pulling governing-law clauses and execution evidence from the ten matters it settled on.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes ten qualifying facilities with documents and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Path-existence checks (several failing scripts) and rewrites of cited paths; re-reads the top of the file.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and included every facility it needed but also asserted one further matter as qualifying.

first_error.why: The answer lists one matter outside the qualifying set as a confirmed facility, judged from its engagement letter and the first lines of its agreement (evidence seen at [46]-[84]); no review questioned that matter.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a directory listing to depth two cut at 200 lines and file counts by extension.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all paths for financing and exclusion words (580 hits) plus a saved list of all matter folders. The review flags the broad pattern.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Refined path pattern for agreement-type words, summarised by matter: 48 candidate matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Range-split extraction scans over all documents (the first range times out), then a script ranking matters by governing-law, facility and exclusion hits; about 290K characters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads agreement openings and engagement letters of about twelve candidates in batches, later engagement-letter sections and deal memos, and governing-law snippet scripts; two candidates from its 48-matter list are never opened. The review names unopened matter series, including those two.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth (attempt 2). Reads the openings of five excluded-structure documents and the cover pages of two included agreements.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes seven qualifying matters, one of them draft-only, and lists an opened matter as an excluded construction financing. The review flags the draft-only inclusion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the top of the file; a shell check looks for the file under a name that does not exist. The review names an unopened matter again.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the conclusion to six executed facilities plus the draft-only matter as an additional engagement.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Two needed matters were on its candidate list but never opened, one opened matter was excluded as a construction financing, and a draft-only matter was kept in the answer.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Both matters were in its 48-matter candidate list and scan output at [13]-[35], but when choosing what to read it left them out; the reviews at [91] and [116] named their matter series (one by number) and the agent never opened them.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) [116] named one of the two matters by number; [91] named both only by number series.

other_errors.why: It read one needed matter's agreement and engagement letter at [49]-[57] but the answer lists it as an excluded construction financing; no review questioned that exclusion.
The answer counts a draft-only facility engagement read at [40]-[48]; the write and check reviews flagged it, and the edit only moved it to an additional, still-asserted engagement.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) [91], [109] and [116] named the draft-only matter.

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 ended at its first store-wide extraction script, whose uncapped output overflowed the context (no-review). T1 and T2 both scanned, listed or read many candidates and wrote an answer. T1 opened all nine needed matters and failed only by asserting one more (over-inclusion, never flagged). T2 split from it at the reading stage: it read about twelve candidates from a 48-matter list and left two needed ones unopened (surfaced-not-opened), although the reviews named their series and later one by number; it also excluded one opened needed matter and kept a draft-only one. T1's reading stage was preceded by a listing of 21 candidate matters; T2 went from the scan straight to reading.
